First, I know that Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal, and in 1984, there was a significant event held there. I'm thinking it might be the South Asian Games, also known as the SAF Games. I've heard that these games are a major sporting event in the region.

Now, Julian Bolling is a Sri Lankan swimmer. I remember reading somewhere that he competed in several international competitions. So, putting this together, it's likely that he was part of the 1984 South Asian Games in Kathmandu.

So, putting it all together, the competition in question is the 1984 South Asian Games, and Julian Bolling competed in swimming events during that event in Kathmandu, Nepal.
